item.title: Flame Con 2026 sets dates for LGBTQ+ comic convention
item.description: Flame Con, the world’s largest LGBTQ+ comic convention, has officially announced its 2026 dates — and honey, she’s moving to Broadway!After years of serving queer geek excellence in various NYC locations, Geeks OUT, the nonprofit that helms the convention, is taking it to the heart of Manhattan. On August 15 and 16, Flame Con will be taking over the Marriott Marquis New York in Times Square.
